### While Peter Was Still Speaking
Author: Love Worth Finding
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-12-2025.html
Passage: Acts 10:44-46
Points:
- Peter did not convert his audience through persuasive speaking alone; God directly intervened by pouring out the Holy Spirit.
- Lasting spiritual conviction relies on the combined testimony of believers, Scripture, and the Holy Spirit rather than human eloquence.
- Trying to argue people into faith is ineffective because human rhetoric cannot produce genuine conversion.
- The Holy Spirit remains actively present today to convict hearts and produce internal transformation.
- Spiritual understanding comes from the Spirit's illumination and power rather than human intellect or willpower.
